stage: S2b: one development-tuning iteration of the AI director after S2 (development data; never confirmatory)
why: S2 (REPORT_S2.md) measured the v1 director's failure modes: body co-design almost never chosen (56/62 plans), a fixed list-position/timing prior (opt_timing first in the list, chosen in 22/24 pipelines), 12-14% of the budget unspent. Prompt v2 (creature_forge/director.py PROMPT_VERSIONS) addresses these neutrally; it adds no statement about which subsystem usually works.
tuning_parity: the FIX rule was designed with M1 knowledge; this is the AI's one prompt revision on development data; the confirmatory study on fresh creatures decides. Tuning history: v1 (S2), v2 (this run). No further prompt iteration is planned before the freeze unless this run reveals a defect (recorded if so).
pairing: same creatures, same campaign seeds and noise seed as S2, so ai_v2 is paired with the S2 arms (cma_joint, cma_ctrl, fix, rand, ai v1) creature by creature

methods.what: NemotronDirector prompt v2, nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b production config (thinking off), probe/subspace order shuffled per pipeline (recorded seed)
exploratory capacity check: the same director v2 with the 'deep' profile (nvidia/Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b, reasoning_effort low)

analysis: descriptive, with scripts/walk_s2_analysis.py over S2 + S2b shard files together: FULL counts per method x budget; AI decision patterns (body co-design rate, first-probe distribution, budget used); H6 top-2 hit rate vs the S2 census. Decision rule for the confirmatory AI arm: the director version/model with the most dev full recoveries at R* = 2000 among {ai v1, ai_v2, ai_v2_ultra} (ties: the cheaper model, then the later version); recorded before the freeze.
inference: <= 8 requests per pipeline; every pipeline has its own ledger investigation id (fix of the S2 shared-id incident)
